user.title: DigiLifeline
user.description: Switch on the Home Assistant app in the DigiLifeline portal first, then paste the webhook URL and token shown there.

reauth_confirm.title: Update token
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the token. Paste the current token from the portal.

error.invalid_url: This is not a valid webhook URL (it must contain ?household=...).
error.integration_disabled: The Home Assistant app is switched off in the portal. Switch it on first.

abort.already_configured: This household is already set up.

init.title: Critical sensors
init.description: Choose per category which entities send an immediate alert to the DigiLifeline portal. The selected sensors are also shown in the portal.

data_description.val_detectie: Sensors that report a fall. Immediate alert when the state turns on.
data_description.noodknop: Buttons or pendants a person presses. Immediate alert on every press.
data_description.rookmelder: Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors. Immediate alert on detection.
data_description.waterlek: Leak sensors. Immediate alert on detection.

integration_disabled.title: DigiLifeline app is switched off in the portal
integration_disabled.description: Critical alerts are NOT being sent. Switch the Home Assistant app on again in the DigiLifeline portal.

send_test_event.name: Send test event
send_test_event.description: Sends a flagged test alert through the full delivery path. No incident is opened.
